description: Source code for managing passphrases and password files, including functions for creating, changing, and retrieving password entries, with configuration handling and file operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the program; parses command-line arguments and initiates passphrase setting.

methods.name: doit
methods.description: Handles the process of setting a passphrase for a user, including verification and updating the password file.

methods.name: t_changepw
methods.description: Changes the password in the password file, creating backups and handling file renaming.

methods.name: t_makepwent
methods.description: Creates a new password entry with hashed credentials based on user input.

methods.name: t_pwcopy
methods.description: Copies password entries from one file to another, optionally replacing an entry.

methods.name: t_getpwent
methods.description: Retrieves the next password entry from the input stream.

methods.name: t_putpwent
methods.description: Writes a password entry to a file.
